markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (95%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, unflagged input, and all neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 95%, InSitu 4% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / OOD 1.0 | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Invasive | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; strongest concept-model association · Validated
- **Scarce benign stroma or fat** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Low score; absence fits invasive · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 1, 5) · ↑ invasive · Above typical, smaller contribution · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 4, 8, 9) · context · High score, descriptive only · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis, frequent mitoses** (regions 0, 4) · ↑ invasive · High scores; spot checks mostly failed · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Necrosis and mitoses are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- JPEG-degraded simulated frozen section; reliability ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).
- Residual 4% InSitu; duct-confined concept only weakly validated (12/20).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 6, 9**: confirm tumor cells infiltrate stroma rather than showing in situ architecture.
2. **Regions 0, 4**: check necrosis and mitoses directly; automated spot checks failed.
3. **Region 5**: look for residual benign glands, lobules or stroma that the model scored low.
